collection.title: Citroen C1 2014 to 2021 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Citroen C1 2014 - 2021 model requires a 26" wiper blade and the following blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Pinch Tab attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also have rear wiper blades for this C1, click the Rear Blades tab below to view them.
